Uses RFC 9309

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Start a full scan of a public website that the user names. The scan requests each page the way common search and AI crawlers do, compares each response with a rendered browser view, and scores six SEO, AEO and GEO categories. Each scan counts against the user's monthly plan quota. Returns a scan_id.

tools.name: get_scan
tools.description: Status, progress and summary of a scan: overall score and band, category scores, technical health, Domain Rating, rendering mode, platform and the top issues. Set wait_seconds (up to 25) to wait for a running scan to finish.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: All issues found by a completed scan, most severe first, with details and example URLs. Filter by minimum severity or category.

tools.name: get_internal_links
tools.description: The newest internal link plan for one of the user's sites (paid plans): where words already on one page should link to another page, with the Search Console query and average position behind each anchor. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.whywontai.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_scan, list_issues, get_index_status · Private data: check_robots, check_agent_listings · Public sink: get_bing_ai_citations · Destructive: get_index_status, get_plan_pass_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_scan, list_issues, get_index_status · Private data: check_robots, check_agent_listings · Public sink: get_bing_ai_citations · Destructive: get_index_status, get_plan_pass_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
